secrets.name: WB_RUNTIME_FLOOR_KEY
secrets.purpose: the task runtime's own key for the floor model's provider; when it is stored, every run the runtime routes to the floor model uses it, and otherwise such a run uses the lab's key for the floor model (the variables floor_pass_env of evals/eval-gate.json names)
secrets.permission: optional: a key used only by the task runtime, with a spend cap set at the provider, for a person who wants the runtime's runs on a key of their own
